normative_language: RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 (SHALL, SHOULD, MAY in capitals)
change_control: a change to any statement requires a version bump, an impact note in history, and security-owner review

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define the exact production responsibility of Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL document what Enterprise Wasm control plane owns and explicitly does not own.
INV-66 SHALL identify upstream, downstream, and peer dependencies of Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define the authoritative source of truth used by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL document assumptions Enterprise Wasm control plane makes about nodes, runtimes, networks, storage, and control planes.
INV-66 SHALL define tenant, environment, site, and workload boundaries relevant to Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL separate mandatory Enterprise Wasm control plane capabilities from optional optimizations.
INV-66 SHALL document unsupported deployment patterns and non-goals for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL assign an accountable owner and escalation path for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: owners/rotations UNASSIGNED

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL approve an architecture decision record for Enterprise Wasm control plane, its technologies (Cosmonic Control), and its function (Enterprise management/GitOps for wasmCloud).
requirements.note: ADR PROPOSED, not approved

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL translate the source function of Enterprise Wasm control plane — Enterprise management/GitOps for wasmCloud — into testable SHALL-level requirements.
INV-66 SHALL define functional requirements for Enterprise Wasm control plane across cloud, datacenter, near-edge, and far-edge contexts where applicable.
requirements.note: near/far-edge contexts declared unsupported (NA pending approval)

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.
INV-66 SHALL define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
INV-66 SHALL define precedence rules when Enterprise Wasm control plane requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
INV-66 SHALL maintain a requirements traceability matrix from each Enterprise Wasm control plane requirement to implementation and verification evidence.
INV-66 SHALL enumerate every API, WIT contract, RPC, event, file, device, hypervisor, or control-plane boundary exposed by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL use versioned typed schemas for all externally visible Enterprise Wasm control plane contracts.
INV-66 SHALL define authentication requirements at each Enterprise Wasm control plane boundary.
requirements.note: live IdP/JWKS discovery and revocation not integrated

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Enterprise Wasm control plane boundary.
INV-66 SHALL define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define structured failure codes and machine-readable error details for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
INV-66 SHALL document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Enterprise Wasm control plane interfaces.
INV-66 SHALL provide reference examples and conformance fixtures for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL create automated integration tests proving Enterprise Wasm control plane interoperates with adjacent architectural layers.
requirements.note: exercised against protocol-faithful stubs, not real INV-63/GAP-13/IdP/registry/wasmCloud

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL select and pin approved implementations, versions, or specifications for Enterprise Wasm control plane: Cosmonic Control.
requirements.note: Cosmonic Control/wasmCloud versions not pinned (no integration); hash lock pending

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.
INV-66 SHALL support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.
INV-66 SHALL record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
INV-66 SHALL apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
INV-66 SHALL define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Enterprise Wasm control plane changes.
INV-66 SHALL keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Enterprise Wasm control plane configuration and diagnostics.
INV-66 SHALL provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Enterprise Wasm control plane operation.
requirements.note: container base image not pinned/built here

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL threat-model Enterprise Wasm control plane against malicious tenants, compromised workloads, hostile inputs, supply-chain compromise, and control-plane abuse.
INV-66 SHALL apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL eliminate ambient filesystem, network, device, kernel, and secret authority wherever Enterprise Wasm control plane permits.
requirements.note: sandboxing declared in unit/image, not verified on a host

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL authenticate nodes, peers, artifacts, providers, and control-plane actors before trust is granted.
requirements.note: node/provider attestation absent

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: no transparency log; live registry resolution absent

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL enforce tenant/workload isolation across Enterprise Wasm control plane execution, memory, state, network, and device boundaries as applicable.
INV-66 SHALL encrypt sensitive Enterprise Wasm control plane data in transit and at rest with managed key rotation.
requirements.note: managed KMS keys absent; local keyring only

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define safe behavior when identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services are unavailable.
INV-66 SHALL emit tamper-evident audit events for security-sensitive Enterprise Wasm control plane operations.
INV-66 SHALL run adversarial tests for privilege escalation, injection, replay, spoofing, escape, side channels, and resource exhaustion.
INV-66 SHALL enumerate component, process, VM, node, site, network, provider, dependency, and control-plane failures affecting Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL define automated health and stall detection thresholds for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
INV-66 SHALL implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Enterprise Wasm control plane failure cascades.
INV-66 SHALL define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
requirements.note: single-site lease over shared storage; multi-site replication absent

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
INV-66 SHALL define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Enterprise Wasm control plane state.
INV-66 SHALL protect against split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale controllers, or duplicate execution where relevant.
INV-66 SHALL provide quarantine, freeze, disable, or isolation controls for unsafe Enterprise Wasm control plane behavior.
INV-66 SHALL run fault-injection tests proving Enterprise Wasm control plane recovery against documented objectives.
INV-66 SHALL establish reproducible baselines for Enterprise Wasm control plane latency, throughput, startup, CPU, memory, storage, network, and power overhead.
requirements.note: network/power overhead not measured; single environment

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define p50, p95, p99, and worst-case performance thresholds for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: thresholds PROPOSED, not approved

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL measure Enterprise Wasm control plane under steady load, burst load, overload, scale-out, scale-in, and recovery.
requirements.note: scale-out/in not measured (single host)

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL measure per-workload and per-tenant overhead introduced by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL identify avoidable serialization, copies, context switches, network hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state in Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL apply locality, caching, direct composition, batching, zero-copy, or kernel-bypass optimizations where semantics permit.
requirements.note: batching of journal fsyncs not implemented (debt D-01)

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL bound memory growth, queue depth, buffer size, concurrency, and resource fan-out.
INV-66 SHALL measure power and thermal impact on constrained edge nodes where relevant.
requirements.note: N/A needs architecture approval

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define capacity models and saturation signals that predict when Enterprise Wasm control plane needs more resources.
INV-66 SHALL block releases that regress approved Enterprise Wasm control plane startup, density, throughput, or tail-latency thresholds.
requirements.note: thresholds unapproved; no approved baseline environment

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL expose Enterprise Wasm control plane health, readiness, version, configuration, dependency status, and active capability set.
INV-66 SHALL emit structured metrics for rate, errors, latency, saturation, backlog, and resource use.
INV-66 SHALL emit structured logs with stable node, tenant, workload, component, and operation identifiers.
INV-66 SHALL propagate trace context across all relevant Enterprise Wasm control plane boundaries.
INV-66 SHALL expose high-cardinality diagnostic detail safely without leaking tenant or secret data.
INV-66 SHALL record the reason for every automated decision made by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL provide an operator-readable explain view linking decisions to input state, policies, topology, and constraints.
INV-66 SHALL correlate Enterprise Wasm control plane events with application release lineage and the live infrastructure graph.
requirements.note: live infrastructure graph (observed runtime state) not ingested

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define telemetry retention, sampling, privacy, and export policy.
INV-66 SHALL create dashboards and alerts distinguishing ordinary load, degradation, policy rejection, dependency failure, attack, and software defect.
INV-66 SHALL create unit tests for deterministic Enterprise Wasm control plane logic and state transitions.
INV-66 SHALL create contract tests for every public Enterprise Wasm control plane interface.
INV-66 SHALL create integration tests with every supported adjacent layer and execution tier.
requirements.note: stubs, not real adjacent layers

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL create compatibility tests across supported CPU architectures, runtimes, hypervisors, providers, and protocol versions relevant to Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: only CPython 3.11/x86_64/Linux actually run

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL fuzz parsers, schemas, protocol handlers, WIT/RPC boundaries, or untrusted inputs handled by Enterprise Wasm control plane.
INV-66 SHALL create concurrency and race-condition tests for shared/distributed Enterprise Wasm control plane state.
INV-66 SHALL create security tests derived directly from the Enterprise Wasm control plane threat model.
INV-66 SHALL create benchmark, soak, burst, and fleet-scale tests appropriate to Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: fleet-scale not run

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL create disaster, partition, reconnect, and degraded-control-plane tests.
INV-66 SHALL require machine-readable acceptance evidence before certifying a Enterprise Wasm control plane release for production.
requirements.note: pk_core 100-item gate NOT RUN (pk_core not bundled)

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define production SLOs, error budgets, and support commitments for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: SLOs declared; error-budget policy and support commitment undecided

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL define canary, staged rollout, rollback, and emergency-disable procedures for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: no orchestrator integration for canary

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL maintain a supported-version compatibility matrix for Enterprise Wasm control plane and adjacent dependencies.
INV-66 SHALL define patching, vulnerability response, and end-of-life SLAs for Enterprise Wasm control plane.
requirements.note: SLAs/EOL PROPOSED, unapproved; SCA scanner not run

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL provide backup, restore, migration, or reconstruction procedures for Enterprise Wasm control plane state where applicable.
INV-66 SHALL create day-0 bootstrap, day-1 deployment, and day-2 operation runbooks.
INV-66 SHALL define incident severity, paging, escalation, containment, and recovery procedures.
requirements.note: paging rotations unassigned

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL perform recurring access, policy, dependency, configuration, and architecture reviews.
requirements.note: reviewer dispositions require humans

requirements.statement: INV-66 SHALL track exceptions, waivers, technical debt, and deprecated behaviors with owners and expiry dates.

INV-66 SHALL require a formal production exit gate confirming architecture, requirements, interfaces, implementation, security, resilience, performance, observability, testing, rollback, and ownership readiness.
INV-66 SHALL NOT forward any manifest to INV-63 unless an admitted decision for it is durably journaled.
INV-66 SHALL fail closed (no admission) when the audit journal cannot durably record the decision.
INV-66 SHALL derive the acting principal only from a verified credential and SHALL NOT accept a caller-supplied identity field.
INV-66 SHALL NOT disclose inventory, audit or explain data outside the scopes for which the principal holds the corresponding read capability.
INV-66 SHALL require the configured number of distinct approvers, excluding the author, before activating a configuration generation.
INV-66 SHALL make journal tampering, truncation and full-chain recomputation detectable to any holder of the trusted anchor public keys.
